description.en: A regular person falls in love with a superhero who protects Earth! In terms of circumstances, ability, experience--they are from two different worlds, but they get to know each other, support each other, and then... A unique love story on a planetary scale now begins!
description.fr:
Sauvé in extremis de la mort, Sawada Reisuke ne se souvient que d'une chose : l'apparence de la femme qui l'a sauvé. Alors quand il la reconnait dans la rue, Hoshifuri Kaeri est absolument abasourdie de découvrir quelqu'un capable de résister au système de suppression de mémoire qui lui sert tant. Ainsi, à force de se retrouver malgré les souvenirs effacés à répétition, Kaeri invite peu à peu Reisuke dans son monde, dans sa vie passée à protéger la Terre avec ses pouvoirs.

Mais face aux pires désastres qu'ait connu la Terre, lorsque l'humanité toute entière frise l'extinction, que peut faire un homme tout à fait normal pour protéger l'avenir de sa super-famille ?
description.it: Gli Earthchild sono bambini che nascono con doti speciali e il cui destino è quello di lottare per la salvezza del nostro pianeta all'oscuro di tutti. Ma cosa succede quando un Earthchild si innamora di un uomo comune? Quali conseguenze potrebbe mai portare nella sua vita e in quella di chi ama?
description.pt-br: Uma pessoa comum se apaixona por um super-herói que protege a Terra! Em termos de circunstâncias, habilidade, experiência - eles são de dois mundos diferentes, mas eles se conhecem, se apoiam e depois... Uma história de amor única em escala planetária começa agora!

A guest from the planet of happiness, the alien Takopi, arrives on Earth to spread happiness throughout the Earth and meets Shizuka, a girl who never smiles. Looks like she has problems at school and with friends... What will the simple-minded Takopi face? An amazing story begins!
___

description.en: Rakugo--the ultimate form of storytelling, where everything in a story is expressed with just your body and words. Shinta and his daughter Akane have been seduced by this wonderful form of classical Japanese entertainment. Having observed her father strive to pass the shin'uchi rakugo test, Akane takes her own steps into this unique world!
description.fr:
Shinta s'est perfectionné 13 ans durant afin d'atteindre le statut de Shin'uchi, le plus haut rang des rakugo-ka. Mais malgré sa très bonne performance lors de l'examen de passage, le juge de l'épreuve, l'émérite Maître Arakawa Issho, a décidé de renvoyer de l'école Arakawa l'ensemble des participants sans donner davantage d'explication ! Ainsi s'arrêta nette la carrière de Shinta, qui avait tant sacrifié pour accomplir son rêve…
Mais Akane, la fille de Shinta qui admirait son père et son rakugo plus que tout, ne compte pas en rester là !
description.ja: 幼い頃、父の魔法の様な落語に魅せられた朱音は、父のある一席を機に自身も噺家としての道を歩み始める。17歳になった朱音が目指すのは落語界の最高位「真打」になること――。一流の技量を習得するため、様々な試練が朱音を待ち受け…！？
description.th:
ที่สุดแห่งศิลปะการเล่าเรื่องที่ใช้ผู้แสดงเพียงหนึ่งคนและเรื่องเล่าเพียงหนึ่งเรื่อง --- "ราคุโกะ" นักราคุโกะ อาราคาวะ ชินตะและอาคาเนะลูกสาวของเขาต่างก็หลงเสน่ห์ของความบันเทิงอันสุดแสนจะเรียบง่ายนี้ ในวันที่ชินตะขึ้นเวทีแสดงในการสอบเลื่อนชั้นเป็นชินอุจิ อาคาเนะเองก็ได้ชมการแสดงนั้นอยู่และเส้นทางของนักราคุโกะที่อาคาเนะตัดสินใจก้าวเดินไปก็คือ---- มังงะราคุโกะขนานแท้ที่เหล่านักราคุโกะล้วนมาประชันฝีมือฟาดฟันกันได้เปิดฉากขึ้นแล้ว!

(Source: MangaPlus)
description.pt-br:
Rakugo - a forma perfeita de contar histórias, na qual tudo é expresso apenas com seu corpo e palavras. 
Shinta e sua filha, Akane, foram seduzidos por essa maravilhosa forma clássica de entretenimento. 
Observando seu pai treinar para passar no teste de Shin’uchi, Akane avança neste mundo único.

description.en:
Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years. As someone who’s never gone to school and lived his life dealing in the dark side of the business, he considers himself to have "no prospects with women" and marriage as "something not for him." However, one day, in fear that their lineage would dissolve, his clan warns Gero that if he doesn’t marry and produce an heir, they would have no choice but to... force his little sister into doing "that". Driven to his wits' end, Gero asks the target of his work, a marriage swindler, to...

description.fr:
Gero est l'aîné d'un clan de tueurs à gages spécialisé dans les poisons. Criminel de naissance, malgré son bon fond, il a grandi en marge de la société et s'imagine n'avoir aucune chance de trouver l'amour. Jusqu'au jour où son clan lui lance un ultimatum : s'il ne se marie pas pour donner naissance à un héritier, ils forceront sa petite sœur à le faire !

Or, sa prochaine cible est une arnaqueuse, spécialisée dans les mariages arrangés... Acculé, Gero la supplie alors de l'aider.

description.en: Tokyo, Planet Earth... High schooler Tatsumi Tatsunami lost his parents at a young age and now works multiple part-time jobs to live a hectic but peaceful life with his younger siblings. One day his body undergoes a sudden change... And now mysterious beings are showing up at his house! In order to protect the people he holds dear, in order to protect Earth (or "area"), Tatsumi must awaken! He better, because "they" are already here!
description.it: Tokyo, pianeta Terra... Il liceale Tatsumi Tatsunami ha perso i suoi genitori in giovane età e attualmente si mantiene con diversi lavori part-time, per vivere una frenetica ma piacevole vita con i propri fratelli. Un giorno il suo corpo subisce un cambiamento improvviso... E degli esseri misteriosi si presentano a casa sua! Per poter proteggere i propri cari, per poter proteggere la Terra (o "Area"), Tatsumi deve risvegliarsi! Meglio che lo faccia, perché "loro" sono già qui!
description.pt-br: Tokyo, Planeta Terra… O estudante Tatsunami Tatsumi perdeu seus pais ainda jovem e agora trabalha em vários empregos de meio período para viver uma vida agitada, mas pacífica, com seus irmãos mais novos. Um dia seu corpo sofre uma mudança repentina… E agora seres misteriosos estão aparecendo em sua casa! A fim de proteger as pessoas que ele ama e de proteger a Terra (ou “área”), Tatsumi deve despertar, e rápido, porque “eles” já estão aqui!

description.en:
The year is 2061, when space travel is now possible and commercially viable, and the students of Caird High School embark on their Planet Camp.  
But soon after Group B5 arrived at their planetary camp site, a mysterious and unforeseen sentient light sphere warps its 9 members into outer space, stranding them 5012 light years away from their home planet.  
With the discovery of an old, unmanned spaceship nearby, the students must stay strong, manage their limited resources and remain united in the darkness of space, so that all of them can survive their long and likely perilous trek back home aboard the Astra.

---
- **Won the 12th Manga Taisho Award in 2019**
description.ru:
К 2061 году космические полеты стали совершенно обычным делом. Группа школьников, из девяти человек, отправилась в туристическую поездку на другую планету. Но стоило им высадится в месте назначения, появилась таинственная светящаяся сфера, и перенесла их в открытый космос, за 5012 световых лет от родной планеты. После того, как они нашли заброшенный космический корабль, у них появился шанс выжить. Собравшись с силами, и используя все имеющиеся ресурсы, они начали свой долгий полет к дому.  
  
- Won the 12th Manga Taisho Awards in 2019.

description.en:

But soon after Group B5 arrived at their planetary camp site, a mysterious and unforeseen sentient light sphere warps its 9 members into outer space, stranding them 5012 light years away from their home planet.  
With the discovery of an old, unmanned spaceship nearby, the students must stay strong, manage their limited resources and remain united in the darkness of space, so that all of them can survive their long and likely perilous trek back home aboard the Astra.

---
- **Won the 12th Manga Taisho Award in 2019**

- Won the 12th Manga Taisho Awards in 2019.

description.en: Tokyo, Planet Earth... High schooler Tatsumi Tatsunami lost his parents at a young age and now works multiple part-time jobs to live a hectic but peaceful life with his younger siblings. One day his body undergoes a sudden change... And now mysterious beings are showing up at his house! In order to protect the people he holds dear, in order to protect Earth (or "area"), Tatsumi must awaken! He better, because "they" are already here!
description.it: Tokyo, pianeta Terra... Il liceale Tatsumi Tatsunami ha perso i suoi genitori in giovane età e attualmente si mantiene con diversi lavori part-time, per vivere una frenetica ma piacevole vita con i propri fratelli. A fim de proteger as pessoas que ele ama e de proteger a Terra (ou “área”), Tatsumi deve despertar, e rápido, porque “eles” já estão aqui!

description.en:
Ruri faces the usual high school issues: pushy classmates, annoying teachers, and... waking up with dragon horns!? Just after starting high school, Ruri gets hit with the biggest reveal of her life—she's a dragon! Well, a half dragon. Her mom admits Ruri inherited her draconic traits from her father, who, yes, is actually a dragon. As if dealing with curious classmates wasn't already challenging enough, Ruri and her dragon genes literally turn up the heat in the middle of a lecture. Her life is about to be anything but ordinary!

(Source: Viz Media, edited)
description.ja: 高校生の青木ルリは、ある朝目覚めると突然頭にツノが生えていた！実は父親が龍だから遺伝かも？と母に言われたルリは戸惑いながらも、とりあえず学校へ…。見慣れないツノに興味津々なクラスメイト達に加えさらにもう一つのドラゴン体質が明らかに！？いつもの毎日にちょっとした異変――。
description.jv:
Ruri Sinaga adalah orang bermarga batak yang tinggal di Jepang, Ruri sedari kecil hanya dibesarkan oleh ibu nya yg berasal dari batak tanpa tau siapa ayahnya. 

Pada suatu hari Ruri Sinaga menumbuhkan bagian-bagian tubuh naga, bagaimana kehidupan nya setelah itu? Saksikan lebih lanjut dengan membaca komik ini
description.tr: Tembellik ve çalışkanlık arasında git gel yaşayan ejder kızın gündelik maceraları.
description.vi:
Bé Ruri nhà ta lên cấp ba thì cũng gặp những vấn đề như bao học sinh cấp ba khác: bạn cùng lớp khó chịu, giáo viên khó ở... và dậy bỗng có cặp sừng trên đầu!?

Ngay khi mới vào cấp ba, Ruri đã nhận được cú plot twist to nhất đời mình - ẻm là rồng! À nhầm, là "bán rồng." Bà mẹ đã thừa nhận là vụ này là tại gen di truyền của ông bô rồng thứ thiệt của em ấy.

Đối mặt với bạn cùng lớp còn chưa đủ khó khăn hay sao ấy nên gen rồng của Ruri còn đột nhiên bùng nổ giữa lớp nữa.
Cuộc đời ẻm từ nay chẳng thể êm đềm nổi nữa rồi!
description.pt-br: Ruri Aoki é uma garota normal que um dia acorda com um par de chifres em sua cabeça. De acordo com sua mãe, o pai de Ruri, que ela nunca conheceu antes, é um dragão e Ruri só é metade humana. Esta é a história da jornada de autodescobrimento e aceitação de uma garota metade humana, metade dragão.

description.en:
A catastrophic event has thrust the world into an age where disease begets disease. Ostracized for his unconventional treatment methods, the dark Doctor Ikuru is stricken with an immortalizing disease. On a desperate mission to die, he must save a world desperate to live. This medical science-fiction adventure will go to the very edge of humanity and back in one man's search for an ending to his suffering, all while saving the world he wishes to leave.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: The manga got originally published as a short series of 4 chapters on February, 2020 in Shounen Jump +. On September 6, 2022, the manga got serialized and its 4 original chapters got republished as part of the serialization.

description.bg: Учиха Саске се отправя към астрономическа обсерватория далеч от Земята на огъня, където се присъединява към Сакура и се впуска в тайно разследване, за да търси следи от Мъдреца на Шестте пътеки! Там те откриват план, който надхвърля живота и смъртта... Къде ще отведе битката този съпружески екип?
description.en: Uchiha Sasuke heads for an astronomical observatory far from the Land of Fire where he joins up with Sakura and dives into an undercover investigation to search for traces of the Sage of Six Paths! There, they discover a plan that goes beyond life and death… Where will the battle take this husband-and-wife team?
description.uk: Наруто, найкращий друг Саске, страждає від хвороби, яка блокує його чакру. У пошуках ліків від недуги Учіха вдає з себе в'язня, щоб потрапити до Астрономічної Обсерваторії. Разом зі своєю дружиною Сакурою він повинен відшукати спосіб зцілити Наруто якомога швидше, поки його стан не поставив під загрозу безпеку всієї Конохи.
description.pt-br: Sasuke Uchiha vai a um distante instituto de astronomia. A fim de encontrar vestígios do Sábio dos Seis Caminhos, ele se junta à Sakura e conduz uma investigação infiltrativa. O que é a vida e a morte? O que é um casal e o que é uma parceria? Em busca de respostas, os dois vão à luta!

description.bg: Спин-оф романът на Наруто вече е манга серия! Пенсионираните Какаши и Гай се отправят към горещите извори в Земята на горещата вода с техния бодигард, Сарутоби Мирай! История, която свързва две поколения чрез силата на връзките!
description.en: The Naruto spin-off novel is now a manga series! The retired Kakashi and Guy head to a hot springs in the Land of Hot Water with their bodyguard, Sarutobi Mirai! A story connecting two generations through the power of bonds!
description.id: Novel spin-off Naruto sekarang menjadi seri manga!  Pensiunan Kakashi dan Guy menuju ke mata air panas di Negeri Uap dengan pengawal mereka, Sarutobi Mirai!  Sebuah kisah yang menghubungkan dua generasi melalui kekuatan ikatan!
description.tr: Naruto yan ürün romanı artık bir manga serisi! Emekli Kakaşi ve Gay, koruması Sarutobi Miray'la "Sıcak Su Ülkesi"nde kaplıcalara gidiyor. Bağların gücüyle iki nesil birbirine bağlanıyor!
description.pt-br: O romance spin-off de Naruto agora é uma série de mangá! Os aposentados Kakashi e Guy vão para uma fonte termal no País do Vapor com sua guarda-costas, Sarutobi Mirai! Uma história que conecta duas gerações através do poder dos laços!

description.en:
High schooler Anzu Hoshino has a great life. Every day she plays video games, pigs out on snacks, and pets her beloved cat. But this blissful existence is turned into a confusing mess when a magical creature transports her to an altered reality bereft of her favorite things. Now she’s stuck with hot guys instead! How can she possibly survive in such an awful world?!
___
**Links**:
- **Official English Volumes:** [VIZ](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/romantic-killer)
description.ja:
非ヒロイン属性の杏子の前に現れたのは魔法使いリリ。

リリの魔法によって大好きなゲーム・チョコ・猫が奪われ、

その代わりにイケメンに囲まれた少女マンガのような生活を与えられる。

しかし杏子は仕掛けられるラブイベントをことごとく打ち砕く！

杏子とリリによる、ラブ２割コメディ８割のラブコメバトル漫画。
